crossRefs.note: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them…
Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit…
Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit…
Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge…
“For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for…

translations.web: For who has stood in the council of Yahweh, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and heard it?
translations.bsb: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see and hear His word? Who has given heed to His word and obeyed it?
translations.kjv: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard
translations.asv: For who hath stood in the council of Jehovah, that he should perceive and hear his word? who hath marked my word, and heard it?
